page.title: Insights
page.description: AI-powered portfolio analyses: find diversification gaps and understand how things changed over time.

gaps.intro: Analyzes your portfolio for diversification gaps: missing sectors, regions, themes, company sizes. Returns concrete suggestions.

delta.intro: Compares your portfolio today with the snapshot from {days} days ago. Identifies winners, losers, new positions, dividends. The AI delivers a narrative summary and concrete action recommendations.
delta.headline: Headline
delta.snapshotMissing: ⚠️ No snapshot history available for an exact comparison. Numbers are based on current value vs. cost basis. Snapshots are taken daily at 23:55.

trackRecord.title: AI track record
trackRecord.description: How good were the AI recommendations, measured against actual price performance since the recommendation date?
trackRecord.emptyHint: Run stock analyses and come back in at least 7 days.
trackRecord.note: Hit logic: BUY/ACCUMULATE → hit when return > 0%; SELL/REDUCE → hit when return < 0%; HOLD → hit when return within ±5%. Minimum 7 days old.
